 permit ip 10.10.20.0 0.0.0.255 any
ip access-list extended FILTER-STAFF-IN
 remark === Deny Staff from Management and Engineering ===
 deny ip 10.10.30.0 0.0.0.255 10.10.10.0 0.0.0.255
 deny ip 10.10.30.0 0.0.0.255 10.10.20.0 0.0.0.255
 remark === Permit Infrastructure Services ===
 permit udp 10.10.30.0 0.0.0.255 host 10.10.40.10 eq 514
 permit udp 10.10.30.0 0.0.0.255 host 10.10.40.10 eq 123
 permit udp 10.10.30.0 0.0.0.255 host 172.16.50.2 eq domain

 permit tcp 10.10.30.0 0.0.0.255 any eq 443
 permit icmp 10.10.30.0 0.0.0.255 any
 deny ip 10.10.30.0 0.0.0.255 any
